name: Meet the Guild Master
description: Welcome to Asteria, Adventurer! So your dream is to climb the highest Floor of the Asteria Tower? Well, you have a long way ahead of you! start by meeting Guild Master of the Adventurers Guild, you can find him by following the street and then go east.
dialogActive: Did you talk to the Guild Master yet?

name: Your first Quest
description: Kill the wolves outside of Asteria and bring 10 Wolf Fangs to the Guild Master
dialogActive: Bring me 10 Wolf Fangs. You can find Wolfes outside of Asteria.

name: Boar Problem
description: Boars have overrun my farm! Please help me getting rid of them!
dialogActive: Please help me getting rid of the boars!
dialogReady: Thank you so much! Now i can get to work!

name: Deer Hunt
description: Greetings, Adventurer! Show me your hunting Skills and bring me 10x Wild Meat!
dialogComplete: True hunters don't hunt for sport, but to keep the balance in the forests!

name: Heart of Stone
description: The Golems are usually our friends and help us in the mine, but ever since finding these cursed stones in the mines, they have gone crazy. We have no other choice but to destroy them.
dialogActive: Did you destroy the golems yet?
dialogReady: Thank you, adventurer. It's a pity, but we have no other choice.
dialogComplete: I hope the mines open soon again.
